hints.applies_to: local rent ordinance coverage based on certificate-of-occupancy date
hints.quote: Year built ≠ certificate of occupancy. Several cutoffs use the certificate date (San Francisco: on or before 1979-06-13; Los Angeles: on or before 1978-10-01). A building in the cutoff year should be "unknown".
